title: Atrial fibrillation: type, history and anticoagulation
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's atrial fibrillation and related long-term drug therapy.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for permanent atrial fibrillation.

HPI
Pt is a 61-year-old male presenting for routine follow-up of permanent AFib. Pt reports feeling well overall. Denies palpitations, dizziness, or syncope. Compliant with rate control medications and anticoagulation. No new symptoms since last visit.

Medication List
Apixaban 5mg BID
Metoprolol 25mg daily

Exam
BP 128/82, HR 74 (RRR), Temp 98.6F. Pt in no acute distress. CTAB. Heart and lungs regular. No peripheral edema.

Assessment
1. Permanent atrial fibrillation. Pt remains stable on current rate control and apixaban for prevention of systemic complications.

Plan
- Continue current medications as prescribed.
- Monitor heart rate and rhythm.
- F/u in 6 months.

Electronically signed, K. Nguyen, DO, 05/14/2026

distractors.why: Permanent has its own code; I48.20 is chronic AF, unspecified.
Apixaban, rivaroxaban, warfarin and similar drugs are anticoagulants (Z79.01).
